items.title: Hunter Henry: Agrees to two-year extension
items.body_text: Henry has agreed to a two-year extension with the Patriots, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Luther Burden: Expected to miss one month
items.body_text: Burden (groin) is expected to be sidelined for roughly one month, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Addison: Nearing full participation
items.body_text: Addison (thumb) is expected to be close to a full participant at the Vikings' night practice Sunday, Ben Goessling of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Strong practice Sunday
items.body_text: Tate was a standout in team drills during Sunday's training camp practice, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Luther Burden: Will miss time with groin injury
items.body_text: Burden is expected to "miss a little bit of time" due to a groin injury that he sustained during Saturday's training camp practice, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
